title.hg: Kisi post pe believe karne se pehle

text.en: Lights, make-up, retakes and editing apps make most pictures look perfect.
text.hg: Lights, make-up, retakes aur editing apps zyadatar photos ko perfect dikhate hain.

text.en: Look for 'ad', 'sponsored' or 'paid partnership'. The label can be tiny or missing.
text.hg: 'Ad', 'sponsored' ya 'paid partnership' jaise labels dekho. Label bahut chhota ho sakta hai ya gayab bhi.

text.en: Who made it? What do they want me to buy or do? What did they leave out?
text.hg: Ise kisne banaya? Woh mujhse kya khareedwana ya karwana chahte hain? Unhone kya chhod diya?

text.en: Lakhs of views do not make a video true. Ask a parent, teacher or doctor instead.
text.hg: Lakhon views se koi video sach nahi ho jaata. Uske bajaye mummy-papa, teacher ya doctor se pucho.

text.en: Something for adults or upsetting pops up? Close it and tell a trusted adult. You are not in trouble.
text.hg: Adults wali ya upset karne wali koi cheez aa jaaye? Band karo aur kisi trusted adult ko batao. Tum trouble mein nahi ho.

title.hg: Porn ki script vs real life

points.en: Performers chosen for one look; scenes scripted, cut and edited.
points.hg: Ek khaas look ke liye chune gaye performers; scenes scripted, cut aur edited.

points.en: Nobody asks or checks in, and a no gets turned into a yes.
points.hg: Koi na permission poochta hai, na check karta hai ki saamne wala theek hai, aur 'na' ko 'haan' bana diya jaata hai.

points.en: Protection is invisible, and nervousness, awkwardness and care are edited out.
points.hg: Protection kahin dikhta hi nahi, aur nervousness, awkwardness aur care edit karke hata diye jaate hain.

points.en: Men always in control, women always willing: a stereotype.
points.hg: Mard hamesha control mein, auratein hamesha raazi: yeh ek stereotype hai.

points.en: Bodies vary hugely in shape, size, hair and skin, and all are normal.
points.hg: Bodies shape, size, baal aur skin mein bahut alag hoti hain, aur sab normal hai.

points.en: Pressure is not consent, and no means no.
points.hg: Pressure consent nahi hai, aur 'na' ka matlab 'na' hai.

points.en: Real people feel nervous, laugh, and need trust and care.
points.hg: Real log nervous hote hain, hanste hain, aur unhe trust aur care chahiye hota hai.

points.en: Under 18, no one can legally consent to sexual activity; waiting is a valid choice.
points.hg: 18 se kam age mein koi bhi sexual activity ke liye legally consent nahi de sakta; wait karna bilkul valid choice hai.

text.en: Performers and influencers are selected, lit, filtered and edited, so rare looks start to feel normal.
text.hg: Performers aur influencers selected, lit, filtered aur edited hote hain, isliye rare looks bhi normal lagne lagte hain.

text.en: Genitals and bodies vary widely in size, shape and colour, and that is healthy.
text.hg: Genitals aur bodies size, shape aur colour mein bahut vary karte hain, aur yeh healthy hai.

text.en: Voluntary and can be withdrawn anytime. Silence, pressure and persistence are never consent.
text.hg: Apni marzi se, aur kabhi bhi wapas li ja sakti hai. Chuppi, pressure aur peeche padna kabhi consent nahi.

text.en: In India a person under 18 cannot consent to sexual activity, whatever was said.
text.hg: India mein 18 se kam age ka koi bhi sexual activity ke liye consent nahi de sakta, chahe kuch bhi bola gaya ho.

text.en: Qualified and registered? Selling something? Promising fast results? Do WHO or doctors agree?
text.hg: Qualified aur registered hai? Kuch bech raha hai? Fast results ka promise? Kya WHO ya doctors agree karte hain?

text.en: Losing sleep, failing to cut down or feeling distressed? A counsellor or Tele-MANAS 14416 can help.
text.hg: Neend kharab ho rahi hai, kam nahi kar paa rahe, ya baad mein pareshan hote ho? Counsellor ya Tele-MANAS 14416 help kar sakte hain.

title.en: Real intimacy runs on different rules
title.hg: Real intimacy ke rules alag hain

text.en: Arousal takes time and varies with stress, sleep, mood and trust. Using lubricant is ordinary.
text.hg: Arousal mein time lagta hai aur yeh stress, neend, mood aur trust ke saath badalta hai. Lubricant use karna normal baat hai.

text.en: Talk about what feels comfortable, what is off-limits, which protection you use and how to stop.
text.hg: Baat karo ki kya comfortable lagta hai, kya off-limits hai, kaunsa protection use karoge aur rukne ke liye kaise bologe.

text.en: Every person can say no to any act at any time, and that no must be respected.
text.hg: Har insaan kisi bhi cheez ko kabhi bhi 'na' bol sakta hai, aur us 'na' ki respect honi chahiye.

text.en: Subscriptions and live chats sell a one-sided bond. Watch your budget and your loneliness honestly.
text.hg: Subscriptions aur live chats ek one-sided bond bechte hain. Apne budget aur apne akelepan pe honestly nazar rakho.

text.en: Real treatment for erection, ejaculation, pain or desire concerns comes from a registered doctor.
text.hg: Erection, ejaculation, pain ya desire ki problems ka real ilaaj registered doctor se milta hai.

text.en: Leaked, hidden-camera and deepfake clips are abuse; under-18 content is a serious crime. Report at cybercrime.gov.in.
text.hg: Leaked, hidden-camera aur deepfake clips abuse hain; under-18 content serious crime hai. cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.

title.en: Sextortion or a leak: your action plan
title.hg: Sextortion ya leak: tumhara action plan

text.en: Stop replying. Do not pay, and do not send anything more.
text.hg: Reply karna band karo. Paise mat do, aur kuch bhi aur mat bhejo.

text.en: Don't delete the chat; note the username, number or UPI ID and dates. Never forward or save the image.
text.hg: Chat delete mat karo; username, number ya UPI ID aur dates note karo. Image kabhi forward ya save mat karo.

text.en: Tell a trusted adult the same day. Being tricked is not a crime, and it is not your fault.
text.hg: Usi din kisi trusted adult ko batao. Dhokha kha jaana crime nahi hai, aur ismein tumhari galti nahi hai.

text.en: Use cybercrime.gov.in, 1930, a police station or 1098 if under 18, plus the platform's report button.
text.hg: cybercrime.gov.in, 1930, police station, ya 18 se kam ho toh 1098 pe report karo, aur platform ke report button se bhi.

text.en: Feeling panicked or hopeless? Call Tele-MANAS 14416, free. In immediate danger, call 112.
text.hg: Panic ya hopeless feel ho raha hai? Tele-MANAS 14416 pe free call karo. Turant khatra ho toh 112 pe call karo.

title.en: Seen abuse material? Do this, not that
title.hg: Abuse wala content dikha? Yeh karo, woh nahi

points.hg: Note karo ki yeh kahan dikha.

points.en: Report it on the platform and at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930.
points.hg: Platform pe aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report karo.

points.en: Call 1098 for a child in danger, 112 for suspected trafficking.
points.hg: Khatre mein pade bachche ke liye 1098, aur trafficking ke shak pe 112 pe call karo.

points.en: Women Helpline 181, NACO 1097 and free legal aid 15100 also help.
points.hg: Women Helpline 181, NACO 1097 aur free legal aid 15100 bhi help karte hain.
Ise download, screenshot ya forward karna.

points.en: Assume a smile or 'verified' badge proves consent or age.
points.hg: Yeh maan lena ki smile ya 'verified' badge consent ya age ka proof hai.

points.en: Treat 'leaked' or 'hidden cam' clips as entertainment.
points.hg: 'Leaked' ya 'hidden cam' clips ko entertainment samajhna.

points.en: Believe payment buys the right to force or hurt anyone.
points.hg: Yeh maanna ki paise dekar kisi pe zabardasti karne ya use hurt karne ka haq mil jaata hai.
